title: Chapter 2636 - 65: Religious Con Men_2
content:
Chapter 2636: Chapter 65: Religious Con Men_2

Around noon, he set out with two Elders and a group of Foundation Establishment Realm Danque Tribe guards, leaving the small tribe under his rule, heading towards Da Feng Mountain.

Mo Hua held onto a sliver of hope and followed at a slight distance.

But finally confirmed that, Dan Zhu and the others were heading not to the "Danyang Mountain" he predicted, but to the other side, towards Da Feng Mountain.

Mo Hua sighed.

This "Religious con man" of his had guided the "road" incorrectly for the first time.

Mo Hua was speechless, and finally thought to himself, alright, if it’s wrong, then it’s wrong. No one is born a "Religious con man," inevitably, one takes some winding roads and experiences some failures.

To "bamboozle" others, one must accept the result that others may not accept the "bamboozling."

Mo Hua gradually calmed down his mindset.

Though he failed, he did not lose heart, instead decided to continue following this Young Master Dan Zhu.

The saying goes, one is not afraid of a thief stealing, but afraid of a thief constantly eyeing.

As long as one keeps an eye and continuously plots, one day, this Young Master Dan Zhu will be in his grasp.

On the mountain path of Da Feng Mountain, Dan Zhu and his group marched forward grandly.

Mo Hua concealed himself, hands behind his back, with a leisure expression, following from a distance.

Having walked for a while, Dan Zhu suddenly seemed to remember something, occasionally turning his head to look towards the mountain path on the right, with a conflicted expression.

It seemed that in his heart, he couldn’t let go of the "Divine Lord’s" revelation.

Mo Hua’s heart slightly trembled.

After walking ten more miles, Dan Zhu suddenly stopped.

The guard Elder asked, "Young Master?"

Dan Zhu pondered for a moment, then seemed to make a firm decision: "We change route and go to Danyang Mountain."

The group of guards looked at each other, "Young Master, this..."

Dan Zhu did not explain, only said: "Go to Danyang Mountain."

After speaking, he disregarded others and himself walked toward Danyang Mountain.

"Young Master!"

"Young Master! You..."

The group wanted to stop him, but Dan Zhu is the Young Master, they couldn’t stop him, and could only sigh and follow towards Danyang Mountain.

Mo Hua, spying from behind, was somewhat stunned.

"This Young Master... voluntarily delivered himself to me for a con..."

For a moment, Mo Hua didn’t know if he should say the young man was naive, or that his own "Divine Lord’s" revelation was too strong.

But this was a good thing.

Mo Hua’s eyes brightened.

...

On the other side, Dan Zhu and his group trudged over mountains and crossed valleys, from Da Feng Mountain to Danyang Mountain.

They kept going until reaching a crossroads at the southwest corner.

Dan Zhu stopped, scrutinizing the surroundings, confirming that this place at the mountain’s base was roughly where the voice in his dream, "revealed" to him.

The big guard whispered, "Young Master, this..."

Dan Zhu said, "I am a bit tired, let’s rest here."

"Rest..."

Young Master Dan Zhu is Golden Core, vigorous and strong, what’s there to rest from such a little mountain path?

The group looked at each other, not understanding.

But Dan Zhu already sat cross-legged, meditating on the spot.

The others had no choice but to guard around Dan Zhu, staying vigilant on site.

Time passed little by little, from around 5 p.m., Dan Zhu sat motionless at the spot.

Until the Great Wilderness sun gradually set, with a crimson sky, clouds like burning fire, bursting with magnificent colors.

Only then did Dan Zhu reopen his eyes and look towards the southwest intersection.

But at the intersection, there wasn’t a single figure.

"Was it wrong?"

Dan Zhu frowned, waited for a while, but still nothing happened.

By this time, it was already 7:00 p.m., he had arrived at Danyang Mountain, yet the "revelation" in his dream did not appear.

Silently, Dan Zhu sighed with relief.

"As expected, how can there be any true ’Divine Lord’ in this world? How could it easily give revelation to people?"

"It’s all just a dream, I really overthought it..."

But somehow, Dan Zhu felt a faint sense of loss within him.

Indeed, his heart was confused, needing someone to dispel it.

Indeed, his path was chaotic, needing someone to guide it.

And though the Danque Tribe seemed strong, most of the ordinary cultivators in the tribe were actually suffering, he indeed wanted to give the Danque Tribe hope.

Dan Zhu feared the "revelation" of the deity in his dream really happening.

Otherwise, he wouldn’t know if it was real or not, whether to believe it or not.

But if the deity’s "revelation" didn’t exist at all, Dan Zhu still felt a hidden sense of loss and agony.

The sun set in the west, the sky dimming.

The burly guard Elder said, "Young Master, the hour is late, it’s time to set out."

Dan Zhu sighed, nodded, "Let’s go."

He got up, intending to leave, yet somewhat unconvinced, then looked back again.

In an instant, Dan Zhu’s pupils shrank, he saw at the distant intersection, a vague figure appearing.

This was a very blurry figure, holding a wooden staff, walking from the east, wrapped in the rays of the setting sun.

Behind him, the setting sun burned like fire, with colorful clouds spreading across the sky, a majestic sight.

Strangely, no one knew when this figure appeared or where he came from.

He seemed to materialize from the ether, appearing in everyone’s view from thin air.

Meanwhile, his figure melted with the red sun, resembling a "deity" emerging from the sun’s fire at the horizon.

Dan Zhu was stunned and distracted.

Other Danque Tribe cultivators also felt their hearts shaken.

"This is..."

They didn’t know who this silent and mysterious figure blended with the red sun was, nor what purpose he had.

The Golden Core Elder’s expression turned serious, beginning to activate the magic treasure.

Some guards scattered about, starting to protect Dan Zhu.
